title: Stoichiometry Quest
author: Dr. Dan
description: Stoichiometry study game for CHEM 3A (default) and CHEM 1A. A 9-level Learn Trail (recipe ratios, mole ratios, moles to moles, grams to moles, grams to grams, gases at STP, solution stoichiometry, limiting reactant, percent yield) gives worked examples and step-by-step guided practice with a conversion map. Practice Quests cover mass, solution, gas (STP and ideal gas law), limiting reactant, and percent yield, plus CHEM 1A Reaction to Stoichiometry and Challenge Mode. Includes common-mistake feedback, significant-figure checking, factor-card setup, XP, ranks, and achievements, the embedded Yellow Sheet, and matched videos from Dr. Dan's YouTube channel. Add ?course=1A to the URL to open in CHEM 1A.
